 address ipv4 192.0.2.62 auth-port 1812 acct-port 1813
!

 vlan 10

 vlan 10
 no shutdown

 vlan 40
 no shutdown

 wlan GUEST policy GUEST-POLICY

 security dot1x authentication-list ISE-AUTH

 no security wpa wpa2

 no shutdown
